findings.title: CI geometry fixture isolation
findings.expected_actual: Synthetic geometry fixtures must not require production cgroup resources. Six tests failed on the real publication preflight outside the production launcher.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=openhab/scripts:.ci/solar-pv/analytics/src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /tmp/earthship-audit-20261020-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q openhab/scripts/test_daily_pv_potential.py openhab/scripts/test_pv_legacy_history.py openhab/scripts/test_thermal_weather_conditioning.py: 6 failed, 30 passed
findings.root_cause: Test fixtures injected geometry and guard but not the publication resource boundary. The actual guard correctly refuses ordinary CI process caps.
regression_evidence: Same files plus test_household_cycle_resources.py: 101 passed in 3.41s. Test-scoped preflight injection only; production modules unchanged. Normal shard verification pending.

findings.title: Night-load idempotency retention
findings.expected_actual: A still-admissible request must never execute after ledger count eviction or volatile loss. Original rule re-executed after >32 newer requests.
reproduction: tests/openhab/night-load-override-rule.test.js: admissible identity retention and policy durability
findings.root_cause: Unconditional slice(0,32) on acceptance discarded unexpired durable identities; no payload conflict or pre-admission byte budget.
regression_evidence: Original source: 6 failed / 44 passed. Repaired owner suites: 52 passed, 3 files; max-ID exhaustion and OFF failure included. Full final revision suite pending.

findings.title: Durable override-policy commit
findings.expected_actual: Normal ON device matrix and completion require exact durable OverrideSwitch ON. Original policy persistence could remain OFF while owner completed.
findings.root_cause: commitOverrideSwitch verified live Item then returned immediately after asynchronous persist; no JDBC readback.
regression_evidence: Original source: 6 failed / 44 passed. Repaired owner suites: 52 passed, 3 files; max-ID exhaustion and OFF failure included. Full final revision suite pending.

findings.title: Coherent OpenHAB reconciliation
findings.expected_actual: Snapshots/deltas must reconcile in order, remove withdrawn providers and recover while stream stays live; original older snapshots overwrote deltas and hangs/failures prevented recovery.
reproduction: New reconciliation/deadline/catalog group:25 failed/66 passed; App original:2 failed and unhandled503.
findings.root_cause: Merged snapshots without epoch/per-resource ordering; no independent resync retry, first-open reconciliation, bounded reads or owned teardown.
regression_evidence: Complete interim unit run:182files/2743passed, Node24 with test-only .codex import adapter; standard Node22 final clone gate pending.

findings.title: Supervised sensor duration
findings.expected_actual: 1000 elapsed contact seconds must count only 120 supervised seconds when communication expires at 120; original counted 1000.
findings.root_cause: History clipped contact validity but ignored communication intervals; timestamp-only barriers also suppressed valid later recovery.

findings.title: Thermal crossing-interval irradiation
findings.expected_actual: A 285-second overlap at 100 plus 15 seconds at 900 W/m² yields 140 W/m², not 900. Both raw and corrected intervals must conserve hourly irradiation.
findings.root_cause: The five-minute endpoint chose a single trailing-hour mean for a crossing step; conditioned forcing repeated that endpoint selection.
regression_evidence: Original: 5 failed/6 passed. Repaired raw/corrected native capture plus frozen household replay: 68 passed in 17.85s across four files.
